description: Type createPrimaryIp's retryable quota failure. The OpenAPI document only declares 4xx/5xx wildcards, so it currently lands as Forbidden (403 resource_limit_exceeded, message 'Primary IP limit exceeded'). A dedicated tag lets callers retry without matching on message text — the quota is commonly exhausted transiently by sibling deployments whose Servers hold auto-created Primary IP pairs.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The project has no remaining Primary IP quota (Hetzner `resource_limit_exceeded`, HTTP 403). Often transient — Servers hold auto-created Primary IP pairs that free up on delete — retry.
